channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Scoggins: Vikings-Giants game is a compelling argument against an 18-game NFL season
item.description: After an injury- and penalty-filled experience at MetLife Stadium, any conversation about adding another game to the schedule should be punted to the moon.

item.title: Opinion | This is our first Christmas without our daughter, Harper Moyski
item.description: She was one of two children killed in the Annunciation shooting in August. In the darkness of this winter, here’s what gives me hope.

item.title: RandBall: J.J. McCarthy isn’t good enough to be injured this often
item.description: Like it or not, there is a sliding scale of tolerance for injuries and off-field issues related to talent and production.

item.title: Where to eat at MSP Airport when traveling for the holidays
item.description: A plethora of Minnesota-based restaurants have taken flight at the airport over the years.

item.title: Minnesota Department of Corrections head receives vote of no confidence from sheriffs’ group
item.description: Sheriffs complain about “burdensome inspections,” while the department contends its actions are rooted in law.

item.title: This Twin Cities suburb just made it harder for residents to petition for an audit
item.description: West St. Paul increased the number of voters needed to push the City Council to ask the state for a financial review.

item.title: Trump says Mike Lindell ‘deserves’ to be Minnesota governor — but it’s not an endorsement
item.description: The MyPillow CEO thanked Trump for his words of support but said he did not interpret it as a formal endorsement.

item.title: Police: Man arrested, accused of trailing federal agents and brandishing gun in West St. Paul
item.description: The apprehension of the 63-year-old man comes amid ICE’s immigration crackdown in Minnesota.

item.title: AG lawsuit: Woodbury couple lived lavish lifestyle off false pledges to land visas for clients’ relatives
item.description: “No one should be taken advantage of because they miss their family,” said Minnesota Attorney General Keith Ellison.

item.title: U.S. House Oversight Committee expands investigation into Minnesota fraud
item.description: Republican U.S. Rep. James Comer is seeking information from state and federal officials. The Walz administration called the requests a “coordinated political attack.”
